held_out_strategy: Single joint spatio-temporal holdout slice on synthetic test fixture (year=2020, block_id=121_-51). Note: This single hold-out slice demonstrates pipeline metrics only; it does NOT claim separate or orthogonal temporal and geographic cross-validation folds.
coverage_policy: PRELIMINARY_UNADJUSTED_CALIBRATION: Records with 'unknown' or 'coverage_unadjusted' status are included for preliminary baseline calibration under Rulebook Section 3 & 4. They do NOT represent verified clear-sky observation proof or verified fire-free zeros.

metrics.poisson_deviance_scale: mean_poisson_deviance is normalized per block-month record (2/N * sum(d_i)); total_poisson_deviance is unnormalized sum (2 * sum(d_i)).

scientific_limitations: Cannot recover missed detections when modis_count is zero.
Evaluated strictly on synthetic mock fixture; not validated against true NASA FIRMS Pará observations.
A larger, multi-year empirical dataset will be required to execute separate temporal and spatial holdout experiments.
